extracted.intended_audience: producers and editorial staff at Channel 4
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for Channel 4 producers and editorial staff on legal, regulatory and best-practice checks to perform before making or publishing content. Emphasises four pre-action questions, escalation rules, and completing an introductory compliance e-module.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discuss plans with commissioning editor and legal & compliance adviser
rubrics_metrics.description: Have you discussed your plans with your commissioning editor and Channel 4 legal & compliance adviser?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the first of four mandatory pre-action questions to ask before making any content decision; if it applies to you (see site symbol), you must refer up to your legal & compliance contact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treat everyone in the programme fairly
rubrics_metrics.description: Is everyone in the programme being treated fairly?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure fair treatment of contributors/participants as part of editorial decision-making; if unsure or the answer is 'no', you must refer up to legal & compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure content accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Is the content you are making accurate?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify factual accuracy before publishing; any uncertainty or negative answer requires referral to legal & compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure content is safe, legal and compliant
rubrics_metrics.description: Is what you have planned safe, legal and compliant?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess safety, legality and regulatory compliance of planned content; if the answer is 'no' or 'not sure' you must refer up to your legal & compliance contact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Escalate when any pre-action check fails or is uncertain
rubrics_metrics.description: If the answer to any of the four pre-action questions is ‘no’ or ‘not sure’, then you must refer up to your legal & compliance contact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Across the 4Compliance site, information may be marked with a symbol indicating mandatory referral; follow that symbol and escalate issues to commissioning editors or the legal & compliance team as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freedom of expression within legal/regulatory parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: Channel 4 is committed to freedom of expression and to publishing challenging, creative and bold content, within the parameters of guidelines, the law and relevant regulation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Balance creative ambition with adherence to Channel 4 guidelines, legal obligations and relevant regulation when making editorial decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete introductory e-module for overview
rubrics_metrics.description: Ready to get started? Have a look at our introductory e-module for an overview of the main issues you need to be aware of.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New staff are encouraged to complete the e-module as an accessible introduction to the main legal and compliance issues; it is presented as a recommended first step for those new to working with the Legal & Compliance team.
